t: A very low-power STM32 chip line for sensors that run for years on tiny batteries.
steps: Buy a NUCLEO-U385RG-Q board from the ST eStore or a parts distributor.
Install the Arduino IDE on your computer.
Add the STM32duino board package in the Arduino Boards Manager.
Pick the Nucleo U385RG-Q board from the board list.
Plug the board in with a USB cable.
Open the Blink example and upload it.
Try Zephyr or STM32CubeIDE next for the deep low-power modes.
